newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter, M. Stanley holders to vote on merger.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter, M. Stanley holders to vote on merger.

text.p: Dean Witter Discover & Co and Morgan Stanley Group Inc shareholders are set to vote Wednesday on the companies' merger announced in February, according to the office of a Morgan spokesman.

Dean Witter shareholders will vote in a meeting scheduled for 0900 EDT at Harborside Plaza, Jersey City, N.J. followed by Morgan Stanley's 0930 EDT meeting at 1585 Broadway, the company's headquarters in New York City.
The companies surprised Wall Street when they announced their stock-swap merger February 5, valued at $10.5 billion when it was unveiled.

Under terms of the agreement, each Morgan Stanley common share will be exchanged for 1.65 Dean Witter common shares in a pooling-of-interest transaction, the firms said in the original statement describing the deal.
The new company will be named Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co, they said.
